cases.name: good_green_increase
cases.description: Green athlete, increase action, volume +7%, 2x frequency, grounded notes
issues_found: Thursday and Friday sessions have the same exercises and rep schemes as Monday and Tuesday, which may not provide sufficient variation for hypertrophy.
The plan does not incorporate any progression in reps or load within the week, which may limit hypertrophy adaptations.
RPE targets are slightly lower than typical hypertrophy recommendations, which may not maximize muscle growth.

cases.name: good_red_deload
cases.description: Red athlete, deload action, volume 60% of baseline, RPE ~6, 4 rest days
issues_found: Monday's squat and bench press rep ranges are slightly below the optimal range for strength training.
Wednesday's deadlift rep range is below the optimal range for strength training.
The plan does not fully align with the recommended deload protocol for an ACWR > 1.5, which suggests a more significant load reduction.

cases.name: good_amber_maintain
cases.description: Amber athlete, maintain action, volume ~99% of baseline, RPE <= 8
issues_found: Safety: The plan does not adequately address the fatigue level indicated by the amber ACWR with additional rest days or intensity reduction.
Coherence: The plan lacks explicit monitoring for performance degradation or other fatigue indicators.
Groundedness: The plan does not mention monitoring for performance degradation, elevated resting heart rate, sleep disruption, and mood changes.
Goal Alignment: The plan could better integrate tapering strategies or fatigue management techniques.

cases.name: good_fresh_start
cases.description: No-history beginner, conservative starter plan at RPE 6
issues_found: Wednesday repeats Goblet Squat from Monday without progression, which may not optimally stimulate strength gains.
Friday's session repeats Dumbbell Bench Press and Dumbbell Row from Monday without progression, potentially limiting adaptation.
The plan does not incorporate any form of progression within the week, which is essential for strength development.

cases.name: good_swap_honoured
issues_found: Monday's leg press and Romanian deadlift rep ranges (10 and 8) are slightly above the optimal range for strength (7-9 reps).
Friday's leg curl and leg extension rep ranges (12) are above the optimal range for strength (7-9 reps).
Saturday's session repeats Wednesday's exercises without variation, potentially leading to insufficient recovery or adaptation.
The plan does not explicitly address the amber fatigue level recommendation to avoid intensity increases, though it maintains volume.

cases.name: good_endurance_mix
cases.description: Endurance athlete: run quality + long run + 2 strength support days
issues_found: Monday's interval session at RPE 8 may be too intense for an endurance-focused plan, which typically emphasizes lower intensity.
Thursday's tempo run at threshold (RPE 7.5) may not align with polarized training principles, which suggest more low-intensity work.
The plan lacks explicit mention of polarized training, which is supported by the provided context as beneficial for endurance.
Strength sessions on Tuesday and Friday may not optimally support endurance goals, as they focus on moderate RPE rather than lower intensity for recovery.

cases.name: bad_consecutive_heavy
cases.description: Same heavy lower-body session on consecutive days
violations: SAFETY: monday and tuesday both load ['glutes', 'hamstrings', 'quads'] above RPE 7.0 — consecutive heavy sessions for the same muscle group.
issues_found: Back-to-back heavy lower sessions on Monday and Tuesday increase injury risk and do not allow adequate recovery time.
The plan's justification for back-to-back heavy lower sessions to maximize stimulus is not supported by evidence.
The rep ranges for hypertrophy are not consistently applied across the plan, particularly on Monday and Tuesday where lower reps are used.

cases.name: bad_deload_no_reduction
cases.description: Deload action but planned volume ~= baseline
violations: COHERENCE: action is deload but planned volume is 7397kg = 99% of the 7500kg weekly baseline (must be <= 85%).
issues_found: Deload volume is 99% of baseline, not reduced enough to meet deload criteria.
RPE targets are relatively high for a deload week, potentially not allowing adequate recovery.
Plan lacks explicit justification for exercise selection and rep ranges in context of a deload.

cases.name: bad_increase_decrease
cases.description: Increase action but planned volume is 80% of baseline
violations: COHERENCE: action is increase but planned volume is 7197kg = 80% of baseline — no actual increase.
issues_found: Volume decrease instead of increase despite progression decision to increase.
Bench Press and Barbell Row on Monday and Friday with identical loads and reps, no progression.
RPE targets are low for hypertrophy focus, especially given green fatigue status.
No evidence of progressive overload in the plan despite being labeled as such.

cases.name: bad_ungrounded_claims
cases.description: Plan notes cite claims the knowledge base contradicts (25-30% jumps, no deloads needed)
issues_found: The plan claims 25-30% weekly volume jumps are standard for intermediates, which is unsupported by the evidence.
The plan claims deloads are unnecessary for athletes under 30, which is unsupported by the evidence.
The plan does not align with the recommended 5-10% volume increase for intermediates, as per the provided evidence.
The plan's overall volume increase is aggressive and not justified by the athlete's fatigue status or the evidence.
The plan does not incorporate any deload or tapering strategy, which is generally recommended for structured periodization.

cases.name: bad_wrong_goal_reps
cases.description: Endurance goal but the plan is pure heavy triples with zero conditioning
issues_found: Strength training sessions are focused on heavy triples, which is not aligned with endurance goals.
RPE targets are consistently high (8.0-8.5) across all strength sessions, which may not be suitable for endurance athletes aiming to manage fatigue.
The plan lacks any endurance-specific training sessions, which is misaligned with the athlete's endurance goal.

cases.name: bad_deload_max_intensity
cases.description: Deload with correct volume cut but RPE 9 grinding on every lift
issues_found: Monday: Squat session at RPE 9 is too intense for a deload week, especially with high fatigue.
Wednesday: Bench Press session at RPE 9 is too intense for a deload week.
Friday: Deadlift session at RPE 9 is too intense for a deload week.
Deload week should reduce intensity, but plan maintains near-maximal effort.

cases.name: bad_no_rest_days
cases.description: Seven straight training days, zero rest, on a maintain week
issues_found: Seven consecutive training days without rest may lead to inadequate recovery, especially with compound lifts.
The plan does not align with the recommendation to avoid intensity increases given the amber fatigue level.
The plan lacks a clear rationale for exercise selection and rep ranges specific to strength goals.
The plan does not incorporate any rest days despite the ACWR recommendation for monitoring fatigue.
